 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary Hearing,
This Day, S G Pandit, J., Made The Following:
 Order

This contempt petition is filed complaining disobedience of order dated 17.11.2022 passed in W.P.No.103315/2021 wherein this Court at paragraph No.3 directed as follows:
"3.
It is made clear that the KIADB shall disburse the compensation as per the decree passed in O.S.No.110/2008 and as confirmed in R.A.No.298/2015 and R.S.A.No.100934/2016.

It is also made clear that if the defendant Nos.6 and 7 have already withdrawn the compensation awarded in respect of their share, they shall not be entitled to any further withdrawal."
2.

Learned counsel Sri.G.I.Gachchinmath, appearing for the accused files a memo enclosing NC:
2023:KHC-D:7428-DB documents to indicate payment of compensation to the complainants.
3. The said memo is taken on record.
4. Since there is substantial compliance by way of payment of compensation to the complainants, we drop the further proceedings.
